units: metres in unchanged canonical source +Y-up/+Z-forward frame
sourceUse: Confirmed commercial-game extraction, explicitly owner-authorized LOCAL measurement/comparison only. No source mesh, topology, vertex/index/texture/rig buffer is included in the first-party additions.

reopenedGate.cause: Actual missing rounded rear-deck service covers and two raised roof fittings, plus a 10.4 mm excessive basket axial radius amplified by a sampled-column boundary. No comparison threshold, normalization, camera or component mask was changed.
reopenedGate.priorEvidenceLimit: The 02:41 passing scores survive in the per-ID note, but its complete raw geometry curves were not durably archived; the earlier parity archive predates final source-world correction. Exact numerical attribution of the old-to-current score difference is not claimed.

serviceCovers.surface: Shallow central circular face, two radial shoulder slopes and a steep outer rim, with source deck rake about 0.05245 in Y/Z. The mildly narrower longitudinal footprint is measured independently. Closed first-party lathed caps penetrate the retained native deck slightly at their actual base; no pedestal or whole-deck height change.
serviceCovers.approximation: First-party 64-sector surfaces approximate the source's minor facet irregularity within 4 mm at held-out radial witnesses. Small fasteners are not reproduced.

aftBridge.construction: Closed narrow arched lug with two low feet on the genuine separate baseplate. Its transverse eye is real empty space, not a dark-painted box.
aftBridge.rayFormat: Z, upper Y, underside Y at X0.0477
aftBridge.reviewCorrection: Independent held-out source rays rejected two draft inner-eye rows that were 12–14 mm too high. Both rows were lowered to the measured source undersides; the central genuine eye remains open.
aftBridge.minorSimplification: Original segmented crown approximates held-out source curvature within 2.8 mm; small foot relief remains simplified by roughly 5–6 mm.

bridgeBaseplate.construction: Separate source low baseplate, with a narrow upper plateau and flared lower perimeter. Its actual bottom overlaps the retained permanent turret roof by 4.095 mm; both arch feet overlap its top. No invented pedestal.

forwardHood.rayFormat: X, Z, upper Y, underside Y
forwardHood.throughAir: Full assembly +X/-X rays at Z0.78 and0.82, Y2.50/2.53/2.55/2.57 remain empty.
forwardHood.construction: Thin canted sheet with separate narrow folded end legs, not a filled block. Its held-out top rays agree within 0.03 mm, underside within 0.4 mm and leg-side rays within 1.6 mm.
forwardHood.explicitConstructionInference: The retained native roof is below the source's occluded support surface, leaving a nominal 13–18 mm gap below the measured leg roots. Only the narrow roots continue downward into the actual permanent roof with 3 mm positive overlap. The measured hood top, visible leg widths and under-hood air are retained; no global roof lift, broad baseplate or pedestal is added.

roofFixtures.ownership: All five named roof pieces are permanent turret-owned equipment, not ERA or ejectable parts. Positive triangle-ray joints and source air are checked at neutral, ±90 and180 degree turret yaw in both detail levels. Every added geometry is disposed exactly once.

basket.scope: Only the floor, two bands and four curved wall sectors receive the source-backed axial ellipse. Their Y coordinates and transverse radii are unchanged; seats, divider, core, gun and rig datums remain untouched. No basket is removed from a mask.
basket.independentReview: Source/native cardinal floor rays agree within 0.067 mm; held-out off-axis floor rays within 3.9 mm and band/wall rays within 6.3 mm. Cardinal windows at Y1.25 stay open.
basket.retainedMinorSimplification: The unchanged lower band ends at Y1.025; the source cardinal opening begins slightly below Y1.02. This small interior vertical seam approximation predates the authorized axial correction.

verification.state: CPU GEOMETRY FROZEN: paired service-cover, basket and roof high/low fixed-source checks pass, including actual support, closed opposing edges, genuine openings, yaw and disposal. The independent held-out review correction is incorporated. Fresh GPU/composed qualification remains pending, not implied by this CPU pass.
verification.preservation: Pre-edit hashes pin every non-target original visible assembly except the merged turretDetail bucket containing the deliberately reshaped basket, which has independent floor/band/wall source tests. Separate independent exact snapshots pin all other 12 X variants in both LODs and ordinary/geometry-receipt construction.
verification.release: Fresh source-fidelity, shaded, geometry and strict proof, followed by final parent-owned anatomy/assets/composed release regeneration, remain required.
